name: Line Counter
summary: Count total, blank, and non-empty lines, plus line endings and length stats — locally.
description: Paste any text to see total lines, blank vs non-empty, whitespace-only lines, longest/shortest/average length, CRLF/LF/CR detection, and whether a trailing newline is present. Complements the Word Counter with line-focused metrics.

faqs.question: How are lines split?
faqs.answer: On LF, CR, or CRLF. An empty string counts as 0 lines; a trailing newline adds a final blank line.

faqs.question: Blank vs whitespace-only?
faqs.answer: Blank lines have length 0. Whitespace-only lines contain spaces/tabs but no visible text.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Counting runs entirely in your browser.
